title: Why The Snooze Button Makes You MORE Tired
hook: Hitting snooze makes you feel more tired than just getting up.

narration.text: Hitting snooze makes you feel more tired than just getting up.
This is called sleep inertia, a state of impaired performance and grogginess.
When your alarm first goes off, you might be in deep sleep.
The snooze button lets you drift back into a new sleep cycle.
Waking up from deep sleep is much harder than waking from a lighter stage.
This deeper sleep cycle is abruptly interrupted by the next alarm.
So, repeatedly hitting snooze leaves you in a deeper state of sleep inertia.
You feel groggier and less alert for longer during the day.
Have you noticed feeling more tired after using the snooze button?

description: Ever wonder why hitting snooze leaves you feeling even more exhausted? It is not just you. This video explains sleep inertia and why repeatedly delaying your wake-up can make you feel groggier all day.
topic: Why you feel more tired after pressing the snooze button multiple times, explaining sleep inertia.
